high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a modern, stylish setting. The individual is wearing a unique, avant-garde dress with a bold, geometric pattern featuring red, white, black, and hints of pink and purple. The dress has a high slit on one side, revealing the leg, and is adorned with small, shiny embellishments along the hem. The top part of the dress is a mix of black, blue, and white, with a buttoned front. The person is holding a small, round handbag with a prominent "LV" logo and the word "MOTION" written vertically
